name: io.github.sweetcornna/free-search-mcp
title: Free Search
description: Keyless Rust search, ask & exec MCP server: web, 500+ sources, academic OA fulltext, local docs.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional outbound proxy URL (http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://) for networks that block search engines.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_MCP_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Optional default region-language for results, e.g. us-en, uk-en, cn-zh. Default: us-en.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory for the local SQLite search/page cache. Default: ~/.cache/search-mcp.
